title: User Login Success
description: Verify that users can successfully log in with valid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username/email and password
Click login button
Verify that user is redirected to main dashboard

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login is rejected with invalid username or password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid username/email or password
Click login button
Verify that error message 'Invalid username or password' is displayed

title: Password Reset Request
description: Verify that users can request a password reset using registered email.

steps.description: Navigate to forgot password page
Enter registered email and submit
Verify that a password reset email is sent

title: Create New Booking with Available Slot
description: Verify that a customer can create a booking when the selected time slot is available.

steps.description: Use AI voice agent to initiate booking process for a specific service
Agent checks availability for requested time slot
Verify availability check returns positive
Customer confirms booking
Verify booking is created in database with correct details
Verify corresponding event is created and synced in Google Calendar

title: Booking Creation Failure due to Unavailable Slot
description: Verify that booking cannot be created if selected time slot is unavailable.

steps.description: Use AI voice agent to initiate booking for a time slot already booked
Agent checks availability for requested time slot
Verify availability check returns negative with appropriate message
Verify booking is not created in database

title: Reschedule Existing Booking Successfully
description: Verify that a booking can be rescheduled to a new available time slot.

steps.description: Login as business owner and navigate to booking management
Select an existing booking and request reschedule
Choose a new available time slot and confirm reschedule
Verify booking details are updated with new time
Verify Google Calendar event is updated accordingly

title: Reschedule Booking to Unavailable Slot Fails
description: Verify that rescheduling fails when the new time slot is unavailable.

steps.description: Login as business owner and select booking to reschedule
Attempt to reschedule to a fully booked time slot
Verify an error is shown preventing reschedule
Verify booking remains at the original time

title: Real-Time AI Voice Agent Conversation Success
description: Validate that AI voice agent handles real-time voice conversation within 500ms response latency during booking.

steps.description: Initiate call to AI voice agent via web demo or phone
Engage in natural language conversation requesting booking details
Verify AI agent transcribes speech-to-text accurately in real-time
Verify AI replies with natural voice response with latency under 500ms
Verify booking is confirmed and saved with proper data

title: Call Logs and Transcripts Storage and Search
description: Ensure that call logs, transcripts, and outcomes are stored correctly and can be searched.

steps.description: Complete several calls with the AI voice agent booking appointments
Navigate to call logs page
Search call logs by customer name, date, or outcome
Verify that call logs with transcripts and outcomes appear correctly

title: Analytics Dashboard Metrics and Filtering
description: Verify that analytics dashboard displays correct metrics and supports filters and data export.

steps.description: Log in as business owner and navigate to analytics dashboard
View revenue, booking, and call performance charts
Apply various filters such as date ranges and service types
Verify charts update correctly based on filters
Export analytics data as CSV or PDF
Verify exported file matches visible data

title: Business Settings Update and Persistence
description: Verify that updates to business info, scheduling, and AI assistant settings persist and reflect in system behavior.

steps.description: Login to settings page as business owner
Modify business info, schedule availability, and AI personality settings
Save changes
Verify changes are saved and reload reflects updated settings
Verify AI voice agent uses updated personality and knowledge base responses

title: Google Calendar OAuth Flow and Sync
description: Validate OAuth authorization with Google Calendar and ensure tokens are stored securely and syncing is enabled.

steps.description: Login as business owner and navigate to Google Calendar integration page
Initiate OAuth authorization with Google account
Complete OAuth authorization flow
Verify OAuth tokens are stored securely
Create bookings and verify they sync to Google Calendar
Verify that calendar events reflect up-to-date booking info

title: AI Service Extraction from URLs
description: Validate AI powered extraction of service information from provided URLs with all 6 modes.

steps.description: Provide a URL via the service extraction feature
Select each of the 6 extraction modes sequentially
Verify extracted service content is relevant and correctly summarized for each mode

title: Knowledge Base CRUD and AI Summarization
description: Verify that users can create, read, update and delete knowledge sources and that AI summarization refresh works.

steps.description: Navigate to knowledge base management
Create a new knowledge source with URL or text input
Verify new knowledge source appears in list
Edit the knowledge source content and save
Verify changes are persisted
Request AI summarization refresh for a knowledge source
Verify summary is updated with AI generated content
Delete a knowledge source
Verify source is removed from list and no longer accessible

title: Pricing Calculation Accuracy
description: Verify pricing calculation for bookings considering taxes, fees, discounts and delivery charges.

steps.description: Create new bookings with varying parameters like service type, quantity, discounts and delivery options
Verify calculated price is correct with applied tax, fees, discounts, and delivery charges

title: User Profile Management and Avatar Upload
description: Validate user profile edit workflows including avatar image upload to Supabase Storage.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile page
Edit profile details such as name, contact info
Upload a new avatar image
Save profile changes
Verify profile updates persist and avatar is displayed

title: Session Management and Secure Sign Out
description: Verify user session persistence and secure sign out invalidates session.

steps.description: Login to the system
Close and reopen browser and verify session is persisted
Sign out from account
Verify session is invalidated and user is redirected to login page

title: System Load and Scalability
description: Verify system performance and booking success rate under expected simulated load.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent calls and booking attempts up to expected max load
Verify zero missed calls and system handles load without failures
Verify booking completion rate is at least 90%

title: Error Handling on Network Failures
description: Validate system gracefully handles network errors during booking, AI voice calls, and Google sync.

steps.description: Simulate network failure during booking creation
Verify user is notified and booking is not partially saved
Simulate network failure during AI voice call
Verify call terminates gracefully with message and prompt to retry
Simulate network failure during Google Calendar sync
Verify sync errors are logged and user can retry manually

title: UI Navigation and Accessibility
description: Verify UI components, navigation system, and accessibility features function correctly across pages.

steps.description: Navigate through sidebar menu and breadcrumbs across all main pages
Verify menus expand/collapse correctly and breadcrumbs update appropriately
Verify buttons, dialogs, tables, and forms render correctly and are keyboard accessible
